cohort: 8008 women in spontaneous labor (without prostaglandins or oxytocin)
finding: Uterine tachysystole occurs in more than 10% of spontaneous labors and is associated with NRFHR, increased rate of caesarean deliveries and NICU admissions, but not with low Apgar scores or meconium-stained amniotic fluid.
mod_finding: Uterine tachysystole was associated with an increased rate of Cesarean deliveries.
